confirmation_policy.current_note: Ten confirmation tasks across five task families are protected; no model-based confirmation run is allowed before freezing.

protocol_snapshot.revision_note: v07 adds adaptive_signals after v06 showed even concise model self-report cost more than it saved. The auditable policy is stored in configs/disclosure_policy_v01.json and uses only task text, named inputs, selected Skill schemas, and dev-derived behavior markers; it never reads verifier labels. Model-based adaptive remains as a failure control. Confirmation remains untouched.
